sentences.text: Researchers conducted a case-control study using nationwide Swedish registers to examine 111 individuals who died by suicide and 1,147 matched controls with epilepsy.

The analysis found that living alone, experiencing four to ten tonic-clonic seizures in the year before death, improper antiseizure medication use, and epilepsy caused by structural brain issues or unknown causes were each associated with higher suicide risk.
The authors note that the small number of suicide cases and missing data on past suicide attempts limit the study's conclusions.
